title: [alpha_factory] Integrate Discovery history and native receipts
body:
[Project notice](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/blob/main/docs/DISCLAIMER_SNIPPET.md)

Connect one six-stage Discovery mission to preserved construction history, frozen later-task comparisons, a thirteen-section evidence docket and typed native Manager, Jobs and Fleet receipts. This proposes additive software version 1.38.0. Continuation #4853 is merged into this existing feature branch.

Current head: `24d58598f896106323f2c120487586bdf5104612`, tree `ffa3d663519e713eca31a9840b8bf6816e53e12a`, sole parent `33b19714e1219c812d451e4d736fcb34b722ceff`. Parent33b preserves previous feature8d96 and main5a as ordered parents. Relative to8d96, this preserves both exact #4856 manuscript checkout files, changes only the outer Agent Release regression timeout60→90, and aligns one runbook paragraph. The runbook accurately distinguishes that90-minute budget from the unchanged historical CI waiter's120-minute wait and125-minute enclosing job. All test commands,80% coverage, functional deadlines, action pins and every other workflow/script byte are unchanged. The complete public tree equals local `9a7744059451cebd70b9fba2aeb46c56818d7fcb`; public commit identity is unsigned and history differs. Fresh main-target checks and configured review are required; earlier source evidence is not reanchored.

The implementation:

- Preserves original v1/v2 histories, reservations, CAS recovery, failed successors and cost records. Six typed construction artifacts bind purpose, charter, model/source/evaluator, predecessors and costs.
- Freezes capability before the future bank, retains seven causal/control alternatives and all rejected or inconclusive outcomes, and exports the complete docket. The measured frozen method succeeds on5/6 future tasks; the static and capability-removed alternatives succeed on6/6 and the static method is cheaper. No broad advantage is claimed.
- Exports actual alternative USDC6 and AGIALPHA18 drafts from the same unchanged pre-Fleet workspace, with raw byte/source/page/history bindings. Native returns preserve that prefix; stale, altered, swapped and unauthorized alternatives are refused without changing the history/docket.
- Audits bounded raw Git metadata before Git calls. Checkout's disabled gc.auto=0 and ignored sparse-checkout/index residue are admitted narrowly; active/ambiguous settings, includes, executable redirects, promisor roots and commondir remain refused. Owned captured-byte module resolution is an import boundary, not a general JavaScript sandbox.
- Preserves all52 current-main PDF/TEX paths, deterministic gallery/mirror/three workers and the unchanged41-input runtime catalog, sourceHash `644258ac21cc938aff861d02ad728e8f3c9716f6ea78700acc35e4d7400eebf2`. Original package release lists remain intact.
- Keeps the interruption test's2.5-second budget through actual child reaping/environment close, receipt/journal and no-replay checks, with delayed-receipt and delayed-cleanup controls. Historical Windows6.75-second failure remains unexplained; current Windows acceptance is required.

Validation retains its source scope:

- Configured review5609403046 on33b found the stale60-minute runbook references. Exact one-paragraph correction now has independent static review, SHA256 `cfdb7faa83e3f3462c218de19331ffa93c538f9ec3d883f472838ba52ce7082a`. Workflow/script bytes are unchanged by this documentation child. All four33b ref-only workflow groups completed original attempt1 success before the normal expected-lease branch advance, avoiding replacement/cancellation of those producers.

- Main-target previous head 8d96, synthetic `54af990513cafe56dbc6059d9fbbef66d9d47671` / tree `865a96862993b2ab669d5344218bee250205c9df`: original capability run39720988664 passed; actual ZIP12400973362 is29,435,049 bytes/233 verified members, SHA256 `1f3c5a69b4f22d8433066682f8ac9bdae38677895da566514322c591c4abbe7e`. Fresh41-source Git/raw verification, byte-exact page/catalog rebuild, dual-draft native/history/refusal/docket/reopen and accessibility records are authenticated. This is previous-source PR evidence only. All eleven original workflows on that previous8d96 source completed attempt1 SUCCESS. The other ten workflows'28 actual archives total235,829,244 bytes/591 verified members; capability preview73,260 bytes/5members is separate from both those totals and the main233-member capability archive. Smoke and PR CI Full software qualification jobs were skipped in PR scope, as designed; actual-main qualification remains required. Final old-source custody report SHA256 `fd64530e27913550c8b12d3984c85ead1ad17639b38f0bd30f0e2902c8d8615f`. These results do not qualify33b,24d or main.
- Confirmed original historical Agent Release run39715159595 attempt1 regression job119618803796 exceeded the platform's 1h0m0s maximum, while progressing at93%, before strict checks. The original failed/cancelled record remains unchanged. Independent review and exact one-field YAML proof/actionlint approve the bounded outer90-minute budget. `tools/update_actions.py` was not run locally: it targets unrelated ci.yml and rewrites immutable action uses to mutable tags; the explicit source-preservation requirement takes precedence. No pin changed; unchanged required hosted hooks remain required.

- Reviewed continuationf0: all six original attempt1 workflows succeeded; nine actual downloaded ZIPs total239,692,499 bytes/521 members, with API sizes/digests, CRCs, safe unique paths and every member hash verified. PR capability artifact12400951633 SHA256 `a35c460dab4f12b6fdf4793989180548ec7acc3dd69984a9fbefdbfe8034bf59`.
- Actual browser evidence verifies both currency drafts, all41 public source blobs, exact served page/catalog, native history8→9 with unchanged prefix, thirteen docket sections, eleven refusal dockets and byte-identical reopening. Desktop/mobile accessibility reports have zero violations;226 contrast review nodes have conservative minimum7.0446. This remains PR evidence, not accepted-main or released-installation qualification.
- The metadata correction has47 inert cases passing on Node22.17.1 and24.21.0; independent review is clear. Local prospective integration701 passes both actual Git manuscript-byte regressions. Earlier full452 Node/1034 Python and strict/hook results retain their original source scope. The configured Semgrep pass covered two Solidity rules and zero applicable Python files.
- [Public69-file preservation packet](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/tree/8ea534091209907085dd00c3f70292199c69ceeb/evidence/discovery-index-and-517-custody-20261022): manifest SHA256 `1753ab14a5dac517197bccca27d68460f43df50fd00294387353217e22f7fe0b`; every published raw file/tree mode/size/blob was read back. Failed8d/fa/517 originals and the paper Windows failure remain failures. No workflow rerun/cancellation or blocked execution probe was requested by this work.

Required before publication: current main-target PR checks and configured review; qualified normal main merge; then complete actual-main CI and Agent release acceptance, including environment/hooks, dependency, Python/Windows, native, recovery, browser/accessibility and packaging gates. Verify fresh1.38.0 public assets and actual Pages/PDF/catalog bytes. Companion installed profiles remain held until that accepted Alpha source and one authenticated original main-push browser packet are frozen, reviewed and consumed by both installed runtimes with complete separate regression/history/docket audits.

The39-record deployment inventory is implemented; approved current read-only RPC observation is NOT_RUN. The real-task adapter is implemented; an operational model/tool pilot is NOT_RUN. Costs retain unknown coordination/review/energy/billing and totalComplete:false. Remote execution remains unprovisioned; no wallet signing, funding, transactions, approvals, governance, unpausing, institutional independence or economic/general capability is asserted.
